entries:
Glad you came!
Your {VAR 0102 0000}'s doing just fine.

{VAR 0100 0000} received the Egg from
the Day-Care Man.
You take good care of it.

You have no room for it right now...
Come back when you've made room.

I really will keep it.
You do want this Egg, yes?

Well then, I'll hang on to it.
Thanks!

I'm the Day-Care Lady.
We can raise Pokémon for you.{VAR BE01}
Would you like us to raise
your Pokémon?

Very good.
Come again.

Ah, there you are!
My husband was looking for you.

Which Pokémon should we raise
for you?{VAR BE01}

Now, now.
That is merely an Egg!

Fine, we'll raise your {VAR 0102 0000}
for a while.{VAR BE01}
Come back for it later.

We can raise two of your Pokémon.
Would you like us to raise another?

You have energetic Pokémon.
Do you want your Pokémon back?

By level, your {VAR 0101 0000} has
grown by about {VAR 0201 0001}.{VAR BE01}
You don't have enough money...

{VAR 0100 0001} took {VAR 0101 0000} back
from the Day-Care Lady.{VAR BE01}

Do you want to take back the other
one, too?
